question: Can even immense material wealth justify giving away this kaula teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels represents immense wealth
Someone might possess such an accumulation
This wealth is posed as a hypothetical offering
inference: Even the offer of an ocean full of jewels is not sufficient grounds for transmission.
uncertainties: The token ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is irregular and likely corrupt or compressed.
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation enough to fill the ocean with jewels.
